final: WITH invoice_averages AS (SELECT i.InvoiceId, c.Country, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_unit_price FROM Invoice AS i JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId LEFT JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country), deviations AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, average_unit_price - AVG(average_unit_price) OVER () AS deviation FROM invoice_averages), results AS (SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS country_adjusted_deviation FROM deviations), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY country_adjusted_deviation DESC) AS position FROM results) SELECT InvoiceId, Country, average_unit_price, deviation, country_adjusted_deviation FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY country_adjusted_deviation DESC, InvoiceId
